name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-schema-form
description: Dev-time type + minimal-runtime stand-in for the dsh-advisor plugin repo. The real package is private (not on the npm registry) and ships from the host dsh app at runtime; this stub provides the consumed schema-form surface (rehydrateSchema / validateDraft / nodeAtPath / getPath / hasPath / setPath / deletePath) with functional implementations over schemastery, honest enough for dev-time store tests. Mirrors dsh-private commit b8343cb (2026-08-09 snapshot).
